ShortcutService defines five RPCs in its proto file.

q14.

**ShortcutService RPCs** (defined in `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto`):

| RPC | Implementing file |
|-----|-------------------|
| `ListShortcuts` | `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` |
| `GetShortcut` | `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` |
| `CreateShortcut` | `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` |
| `UpdateShortcut` | `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` |
| `DeleteShortcut` | `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go` |

All five are implemented on `APIV1Service` in `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`. `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` only wraps those methods for Connect/gRPC and delegates to `APIV1Service`; it does not contain the business logic.
